items.content_html: MVP Word Office.js add-in: stores annex files in SQLite and inserts lightweight tags (e.g. “Annex 1”) into documents. Renaming tags or headings syncs instantly; one click merges all linked annex files into a single PDF. Includes manifest, build config, backend and UI. Requires Node.js ≥ 20, npm ≥ 10, Office 365 Word, SQLite3 CLI and PS or terminal.
